scanNote:
7-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (49-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Profiles' va KO'K yorliqda oq '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
4) 'Fill in the correct words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya ro'yxat: rather, medical, major, successful, improve, sore, standards, treat, meaningful, workers. O'nta nuqtali band: 1 ... doctor 2 ... boring 3 ... throats 4 ... teams 5 ... of health care 6 a ... problem 7 to ... conditions 8 to ... patients 9 health care ... 10 a ... experience
5) 'Fill in the correct word.' Qiya: fighting, organisation, training, GP. To'rt gap.
6) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Bir xatboshida: 1 ... the south ... England; 2 ... the last eight months; 3 to live ... Angola; 4 she had a good career ... of her; 5 to work ... an organisation; 6 ... the area; 7 ... first; 8 to return ... a place
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article in Ex. 3 again and make notes under the following headings, then talk about Dianne Grey.' Ko'k: • Before she went to Angola ... • Since she went to Angola ...

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle)'.
• OCh KO'K quti, yuqorisida oq 'Use': 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT:' • 'to talk about an action which started in the past and continues up to the present.' To'q sariq qiya: 'Dianne HAS BEEN in Angola for the last eight months.' • 'to talk about a recent action whose result is visible in the present.' "I'VE BROKEN my leg, so I can't walk." • 'to talk about an EXPERIENCE.' 'HAVE you ever BEEN to Angola?' • 'to talk about an action which happened at an unstated time in the past. The action is more important than the time.' "He'S BEEN to the dentist's four times." Qalin: 'Time expressions used with the present perfect: just, already, yet, for, since, recently, lately, so far, ever, etc.'
7) 'Fill in the past participle of the following verbs.' Uch ustunda 12 fe'l: 1 break 2 twist 3 burn 4 cut 5 bang 6 scratch 7 crack 8 treat 9 sprain 10 hurt 11 cure 12 hit
8) 'Match the people in the hospital waiting room to the prompts, then act out dialogues in pairs, as in the example.'
   SURAT (chizma): kasalxona kutish xonasida to'q sariq o'rindiqlarda besh kishi: Mr Ellis (sariq sochli, kulrang sviter, bandajli oyog'i stulda, yulduzcha bilan - to'pig'i); Mrs Clark (qora sochli, qizil ko'ylak, qo'lida yulduzchalar - qo'li singan); Tim (bola, yashil futbolka, barmog'ini ushlab turibdi - barmog'i kesilgan); Mr Brown (oq sochli, kulrang kostyum, hassa, qo'li boshida - boshini urgan); Mr West (to'q sariq sviter, qizil qo'li nurlar bilan - qo'li kuygan).
   Ostida ko'rsatmalar: twist ankle ...... Mr Ellis ...... (ko'k qiya, tayyor); burn hand ......; hit head ......; break arm ......; cut finger ......
   Ko'k qiya namuna: "Nurse: What's the problem, Mr Ellis? Patient: I've twisted my ankle."

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '49'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA 48-BETDAGI MATNDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  a SUCCESSFUL doctor
     - muvaffaqiyatli shifokor
  RATHER boring
     - ancha zerikarli
  SORE throats
     - tomoq og'riqlari
  MEDICAL teams
     - tibbiy jamoalar
  STANDARDS of health care
     - tibbiy xizmat darajasi
  a MAJOR problem
     - jiddiy muammo
  to IMPROVE conditions
     - sharoitni yaxshilamoq
  to TREAT patients
     - bemorlarni davolamoq
  health care WORKERS
     - tibbiyot xodimlari
  a MEANINGFUL experience
     - ma'noli tajriba


⚠ 'RATHER':

  = ancha, biroz.
  ⚠ 'rather boring' = ancha zerikarli.
  ⚠ 'quite' bilan bir xil, lekin
  ko'proq SALBIY sifatlar bilan.


⚠ 'STANDARDS OF':

  = ... darajasi, standartlari.
  ⚠ KO'PLIKDA: 'standards of health
  care'.

TO'RT SO'Z - TO'RT GAP.

  1 Greenpeace is an ORGANISATION
    that helps the environment.
  2 A GP is a doctor who treats all
    types of illnesses.
  3 Claire is TRAINING to become a
    nurse.
  4 The armies of the two countries
    have been FIGHTING each other
    for over three years.


⚠ 'A(N)' - 1 va 2-BANDLARDA:

  'AN organisation' (unli)
  'A GP' - 'G' harfi /dʒiː/ deb
  o'qiladi - UNDOSh tovush → 'A'.


⚠ 'GREENPEACE':

  Xalqaro ekologik tashkilot.
  ⚠ 'the environment' = atrof-muhit.


⚠ 'TO TRAIN TO BECOME':

  = ... bo'lish uchun o'qimoq.
  ⚠ 'is training' - PRESENT
  CONTINUOUS: hozir jarayonda.


⚠ 'FOR OVER THREE YEARS':

  = uch yildan ortiq.
  ⚠ 'over' = ... dan ortiq
  ('more than').

items.sentence: Greenpeace is a(n) ___ that helps the environment.
A(n) ___ is a doctor who treats all types of illnesses.
items.uz: Oilaviy shifokor - har xil kasallikni davolaydigan shifokor.

items.sentence: Claire is ___ to become a nurse.
The armies of the two countries have been ___ each other for over three years.
items.uz: Ikki davlat armiyalari uch yildan ortiq bir-biri bilan jang qilmoqda.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI 48-BETDAGI
MATNDA.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  IN the south OF England
     - Angliya janubida
  FOR the last eight months
     - so'nggi sakkiz oy davomida
  to live IN Angola
     - Angolada yashamoq
  she had a good career AHEAD of her
     - oldinda yaxshi karyera
  to work FOR an organisation
     - tashkilotda ishlamoq
  IN the area
     - hududda
  AT first
     - avvaliga
  to return TO a place
     - joyga qaytmoq


⚠ 'TO WORK FOR':

  = ... uchun/da ishlamoq (ish
  beruvchi).
  ⚠ 'work AT' = joy (bino):
  'work at the hospital'.
  ⚠ 'work AS' = kasb (35-bet).


⚠ 'AT FIRST':

  = avvaliga (keyin o'zgardi).
  ⚠ 'first' = birinchi(dan).
  ⚠ 'At first she was shocked, but
  then ...'


⚠ 'TO RETURN TO':

  ⚠ 'return' dan keyin 'TO'.
  ⚠ Lekin 'return HOME' - 'to' SIZ
  ('home' - ravish).


⚠ 'FOR' + DAVOMIYLIK:

  'FOR the last eight months',
  'FOR decades', 'FOR over three
  years'.
  ⚠ Present perfect bilan.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN the south OF England' - ikki predlog.
⚠ Matnda: 'in the south of England'.

items.textEn: 4 she had a good career ___ of her
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'AHEAD of her' = uning oldida (kelajakda).
⚠ Matnda: 'a good career ahead of her'.

⚠ 'to work FOR' + ish beruvchi.
⚠ 'work at' - bino; 'work as' - kasb.

⚠ 'to return TO' - 'to' ShART.
⚠ Faqat 'return home' - 'to' siz.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article in Ex. 3 again and make notes under the following headings, then talk about Dianne Grey: Before she went to Angola ... / Since she went to Angola ...
exercises.instructionUz: 3-mashqdagi maqolani qayta o'qing va quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling, so'ng Dianne Grey haqida gapiring: Angolaga borishidan oldin ... / Angolaga borganidan beri ...
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DAVR - IKKI ZAMON.


BEFORE (o'tgan zamon - PAST
SIMPLE):
  • successful doctor, south of
    England
  • GP in Horsham, Surrey
  • good career, comfortable life
  • job rather boring
  • treated routine problems


SINCE (PRESENT PERFECT /
CONTINUOUS):
  • has been living in Angola for 8
    months
  • has been working hard
  • has treated thousands of
    patients
  • has been training local people
  • has never felt so useful
  • has decided to return


⚠ ZAMON TANLOVI:

  'Before' → PAST SIMPLE (tugagan)
  'Since' → PRESENT PERFECT (hozirgacha
  davom etadi)

  ⚠ Bu farq 7-unitning ASOSIY
  mavzusi.
exercises.exampleEn: Before she went to Angola, Dianne was a successful doctor in the south of England.
exercises.exampleUz: Angolaga borishidan oldin Dianne Angliya janubida muvaffaqiyatli shifokor edi.
modelAnswers: Before she went to Angola, Dianne was a successful doctor in the south of England.
She was a GP in Horsham and had a good career and a comfortable life, but her job was rather boring.
She treated patients with routine medical problems, like colds and sore throats.
Since she went to Angola, she has been working for Doctors Without Frontiers.
She has treated thousands of patients and has been training local people as health care workers.
She has never felt so useful before, and she has already decided to return to Africa.
modelAnswersUz: Angolaga borishidan oldin Dianne Angliya janubida muvaffaqiyatli shifokor edi.
U Horshamda oilaviy shifokor edi, yaxshi karyera va qulay hayoti bor edi, lekin ishi ancha zerikarli edi.
U shamollash va tomoq og'rig'i kabi oddiy tibbiy muammoli bemorlarni davolardi.
Angolaga borganidan beri u 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar'da ishlab kelmoqda.
U minglab bemorni davoladi va mahalliy aholini tibbiyot xodimi sifatida o'qitib kelmoqda.
U hech qachon o'zini bunchalik foydali his qilmagan va Afrikaga qaytishga allaqachon qaror qilgan.

exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect (have/has + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi) — Ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT - 7-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  have/has + 3-ShAKL (past
  participle)

  I/you/we/they HAVE broken
  he/she/it HAS broken

  QISQARTMA: I've, you've, he's,
     she's, we've, they've
  INKOR: haven't / hasn't
  SAVOL: Have you ...? / Has he ...?

  ⚠ "he's" = 'he HAS' (present
  perfect) yoki 'he IS' - kontekst
  ochib beradi: "He's broken" →
  has; "He's tall" → is.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'RT IShLATILIShI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIRGAChA
     DAVOM ETADI:
     'Dianne HAS BEEN in Angola FOR
      the last eight months.'
     (hali ham u yerda)

  2) YaQINDA BO'LGAN, NATIJASI
     HOZIR KO'RINIB TURIBDI:
     "I'VE BROKEN my leg, so I
      can't walk."
     (oyoq hozir singan)

  3) TAJRIBA (hayotda biror marta):
     'HAVE you ever BEEN to Angola?'

  4) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN o'tmish
     harakati - VAQT emas, HARAKAT
     muhim:
     "He'S BEEN to the dentist's
      four times."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VAQT SO'ZLARI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  just - hozirgina
  already - allaqachon
  yet - hali (inkor/savol)
  for - ... davomida (for 2 years)
  since - ... dan beri (since 1986)
  recently / lately - yaqinda
  so far - hozirgacha
  ever - biror marta (savol)
  never - hech qachon


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  PAST SIMPLE - vaqt AYTILGAN:
     'I broke my leg LAST WEEK.'
  PRESENT PERFECT - vaqt AYTILMAGAN
  yoki hozirga bog'liq:
     "I've broken my leg." (hozir
      yura olmayman)

  ⚠ 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in
  1990', 'ago' bilan HECh QAChON
  present perfect ishlatilmaydi!


⚠ 'HAVE BEEN TO' va 'HAVE GONE TO':

  "He's BEEN to the dentist's" =
     borib QAYTGAN
  "He's GONE to the dentist's" =
     ketgan, HALI QAYTMAGAN


⚠ "THE DENTIST'S":

  = tish shifokorining (xonasi).
  ⚠ 'the dentist's', 'the doctor's',
  'the chemist's' - egalik bilan
  JOY ma'nosida.

points.en: We use the present perfect to talk about an action which started in the past and continues up to the present.
points.uz: Present perfect ni o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: Dianne has been in Angola for the last eight months.
We use it to talk about a recent action whose result is visible in the present.
points.uz: Natijasi hozir ko'rinib turgan yaqinda bo'lgan harakat haqida gapirish uchun.

points.en: I've broken my leg, so I can't walk.
points.uz: Oyog'imni sindirib oldim, shuning uchun yura olmayman.

points.en: We use it to talk about an experience.
Have you ever been to Angola?
We use it to talk about an action which happened at an unstated time in the past. The action is more important than the time.
points.uz: O'tmishda aytilmagan vaqtda bo'lgan harakat haqida. Harakat vaqtdan muhimroq.

points.en: He's been to the dentist's four times.
points.uz: U tish shifokoriga to'rt marta borgan.

points.en: Time expressions used with the present perfect: just, already, yet, for, since, recently, lately, so far, ever, etc.
points.uz: Present perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari: just, already, yet, for, since, recently, lately, so far, ever va h.k.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'yet' - faqat inkor va savolda, gap OXIRIDA.
⚠ 'for' + davomiylik, 'since' + boshlanish.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the past participle of the following verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llarning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshini (3-shaklini) yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAROHAT FE'LLARI - 3-ShAKL.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (yodlash kerak):

  break - broke - BROKEN
  cut - cut - CUT
  hurt - hurt - HURT
  hit - hit - HIT
  burn - burnt - BURNT (Britaniya)
         burned - burned (AQSh)


TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (+ed):

  twist - TWISTED (burab olmoq)
  bang - BANGED (urib olmoq)
  scratch - SCRATCHED (tirnamoq)
  crack - CRACKED (darz ketmoq)
  treat - TREATED (davolamoq)
  sprain - SPRAINED (chiqarib olmoq)
  cure - CURED (sog'aytirmoq)


⚠ 'CUT', 'HURT', 'HIT' - UCh ShAKL
  BIR XIL:

  ⚠ Bularda '-ed' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'cutted', 'hurted', 'hitted' -
  XATO!


⚠ 'BURNT' va 'BURNED':

  Britaniyada 'burnt' ko'proq,
  AQShda 'burned'.
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.


⚠ 'TO TWIST' va 'TO SPRAIN':

  twist = burab olmoq (to'piq)
  sprain = chiqarib olmoq (bo'g'im)
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'ankle' bilan
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'TO BANG':

  = qattiq urib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to bang your head' = boshingni
  urib olmoq.


⚠ 'TO CRACK':

  = darz ketmoq/ketkazmoq.
  ⚠ 'a cracked rib' = darz ketgan
  qovurg'a.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the people in the hospital waiting room to the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Kasalxona kutish xonasidagi odamlarni ko'rsatmalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURAT BO'YIChA.

  twist ankle → Mr Ellis (kitobda
     tayyor: oyog'i stulda, bandajli)
  break arm → Mrs Clark (qo'lida
     yulduzchalar)
  cut finger → Tim (barmog'ini
     ushlab turibdi)
  hit head → Mr Brown (qo'li
     boshida)
  burn hand → Mr West (qizil qo'l,
     nurlar)


⚠ 'AN ANKLE':

  = to'piq.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈæŋkl/.


⚠ 'A WAITING ROOM':

  = kutish xonasi.

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Kitobda tayyor: oyog'i stulda, to'pig'i bandajli.
⚠ Oq sochli erkak qo'lini boshiga qo'ygan.

⚠ To'q sariq sviterli erkakning qo'li qizil,
nurlar bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then act out dialogues in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  Nurse: What's the problem,
         Mr Ellis?
  Patient: I've twisted my ankle.


⚠ QOLIP:

  Nurse: What's the problem, [ism]?
  Patient: I've + 3-ShAKL + my
           [tana a'zosi].


⚠ NEGA PRESENT PERFECT?

  Jarohat YaQINDA bo'lgan va NATIJASI
  HOZIR ko'rinib turibdi (qoidadagi
  2-holat).


⚠ 'MY' - TANA A'ZOSI BILAN:

  "I've twisted MY ankle"
  ⚠ Ingliz tilida tana a'zosi
  oldidan EGALIK olmoshi ('the
  ankle' EMAS).


⚠ 'TO BREAK ONE'S ARM':

  = qo'lni sindirib olmoq.
  ⚠ O'zbekchada 'sindirib OLMOQ' -
  inglizchada shunchaki 'break'.
